AcceptedRecipeResponse.title: AcceptedRecipeResponse
AcceptedRecipeResponse.description: The mirror the accepted recipe became or updated.

AcceptedWaitingResponse.title: AcceptedWaitingResponse
AcceptedWaitingResponse.description: How many waiting recipes of a peer became mirrors.

AccountDeletionImpact.title: AccountDeletionImpact
AccountDeletionImpact.description:
What deleting an account touches, for the confirmation dialog.
Backups keep the data until they rotate out.

Allergen.title: Allergen
Allergen.description: The 14 allergens EU food law requires to be declared.

AmountStyle.title: AmountStyle
AmountStyle.description:
How a user reads small metric amounts in recipes, a display
preference only. Counts read as fractions either way.

AuthorizationRequestSchema.title: AuthorizationRequestSchema
AuthorizationRequestSchema.description:
The query of the authorization URL, which the consent page forwards
as it received it.

BasedOnRef.title: BasedOnRef
BasedOnRef.description:
The recipe a copy was made from: with link, title and owner when the
viewer may see it, as an anonymous placeholder otherwise.

accept.title: Accept
accept.description: The differences to write, each as `<kind>:<source id>:<field>`; every other difference changes nothing.

file.title: File
file.description: A `.cui` file or an older recipe archive.

update.title: Update
update.description: Source ids of recipes whose earlier import the caller wants updated; every other recipe imported before becomes a new copy.

file.title: File
file.description: A `.cui` file or an older recipe archive.

CatalogueConflictResponse.title: CatalogueConflictResponse
CatalogueConflictResponse.description: Something of the file that is or was not written as it is.

CatalogueFieldDifferenceResponse.title: CatalogueFieldDifferenceResponse
CatalogueFieldDifferenceResponse.description:
A field whose value here differs from the file's. Field names and
values follow the reference data updates (`names.de-AT`, `allergens`,
`nutrition.kcal`, ...); references are shown by name and conversions as
unit code to grams.

CatalogueSuggestion.title: CatalogueSuggestion
CatalogueSuggestion.description:
A local entry that probably means the same, found by name or alias;
never taken without a decision.

ContentLocale.title: ContentLocale
ContentLocale.description:
The languages recipe and resource text is written in, as BCP 47
tags. The UI languages are the same two.

CreatedPeerInvitationResponse.title: CreatedPeerInvitationResponse
CreatedPeerInvitationResponse.description: Answers creating an invitation: the only time the link is shown.

Diet.title: Diet
Diet.description:
The diets a user may follow. Which ingredients break them is decided
by the ingredients' diet markers (services/diet_rules.py).

DietMarker.title: DietMarker
DietMarker.description: What an ingredient is or contains, as far as diets care.

DirectoryUserResponse.title: DirectoryUserResponse
DirectoryUserResponse.description:
An entry of the people directory, with the avatar so pickers can show
the face next to the name. Every signed-in user may read every avatar.

EarlierImportResponse.title: EarlierImportResponse
EarlierImportResponse.description:
A recipe of the importer's that an earlier import of the same source
recipe created.

EquipmentNeed.title: EquipmentNeed
EquipmentNeed.description:
One line of "You'll need": the highest count a single step names,
and the sub-recipe whose steps need it (null for the recipe's own).

ExtendedNutrientAmount.title: ExtendedNutrientAmount
ExtendedNutrientAmount.description:
An extended nutrient summed over the recipe (`total` for the
servings asked for). `complete` is false when an amount could not be
weighed or a counted ingredient does not state this nutrient.

ExtendedNutrientResponse.title: ExtendedNutrientResponse
ExtendedNutrientResponse.description:
One entry of the extended nutrient catalogue. The amount is per
100 g in `unit` (mg, ug or g); `label_key` names the label in the
frontend's locale files.

FoodFactResponse.title: FoodFactResponse
FoodFactResponse.description: The food fact of the day, about one base ingredient.

FoodRestrictionRequest.title: FoodRestrictionRequest
FoodRestrictionRequest.description:
Exactly one of allergen, ingredient_id, ingredient_name and diet; a
diet goes with kind "diet". An unknown ingredient_name creates a draft
ingredient of that name.

GroupSummaryResponse.title: GroupSummaryResponse
GroupSummaryResponse.description:
What every signed-in user may see of a group: enough to share a
recipe with it.

HandedOverRecipe.title: HandedOverRecipe
HandedOverRecipe.description:
An own recipe or draft that another user's recipe uses as a
sub-recipe; it passes to that recipe's owner instead of being deleted.

HouseholdMembershipResponse.title: HouseholdMembershipResponse
HouseholdMembershipResponse.description: What administrators see: who belongs to which household.

ImportConflictResponse.title: ImportConflictResponse
ImportConflictResponse.description: Something of the archive that could not be placed as it was.

IngredientAmount.title: IngredientAmount
IngredientAmount.description:
A catalogue ingredient (`ingredient_id`) or a sub-recipe
(`sub_recipe`).

KitchenResponse.title: KitchenResponse
KitchenResponse.description:
The viewer's kitchen. Before set-up `set_up` is false, the list is
empty and no recipe is flagged.

LineMarkerView.title: LineMarkerView
LineMarkerView.description:
A line of a step in the applied recipe that the variation swapped or
added; `index` counts from 0 within the step's `ingredients`.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
What the login step leads to. `session`: signed in, the cookie is
set. `totp_required`: send the code with `partial_token`.
`totp_setup_required`: enrol with `setup_token` as a bearer token.

MealPlanScope.title: MealPlanScope
MealPlanScope.description:
Which plan a request means: the household's, which every member
shares, or the caller's personal one, which only they see.

MirrorPlainLine.title: MirrorPlainLine
MirrorPlainLine.description:
An ingredient line of a mirror kept as text, with the source's
allergens and diet markers. `step` is the index of its step (from 0) and
`position` its place among that step's ingredient lines as the source
has them.

MirrorSourceRef.title: MirrorSourceRef
MirrorSourceRef.description: Where a mirror comes from, for cards: "by <author> · <instance>".

MirrorUnlinkedSubRecipe.title: MirrorUnlinkedSubRecipe
MirrorUnlinkedSubRecipe.description:
A sub-recipe line whose sub-recipe is not mirrored here (not shared
with this instance, or not accepted yet); `title` only when the source
shares that sub-recipe with this instance too.

MirrorView.title: MirrorView
MirrorView.description:
A mirror of a recipe a paired instance shares with this one. It is
read only; `source_url` opens it at its source.

NeededEntryResponse.title: NeededEntryResponse

NoticeResponse.title: NoticeResponse
NoticeResponse.description: A pending notice for the signed-in user, in their language.

NutritionSchema.title: NutritionSchema
NutritionSchema.description: Energy in kcal, everything else in grams. Null means unknown.

OwnInstanceResponse.title: OwnInstanceResponse
OwnInstanceResponse.description: This instance as its peers see it.

PasskeyConfirmation.title: PasskeyConfirmation
PasskeyConfirmation.description: An assertion over a challenge from `POST /api/v1/auth/login/passkey/options`.

PeerChannelResponse.title: PeerChannelResponse
PeerChannelResponse.description:
The peer channel in both directions. Sequence numbers count the
events of one direction; the last delivery fields describe the last
attempt to send to the peer, the receive fields the last catch-up with
it. Error fields hold a short category, never the peer's text.

PeerRef.title: PeerRef
PeerRef.description: A paired instance, by its public id here.

PeerSuggestionGroupResponse.title: PeerSuggestionGroupResponse
PeerSuggestionGroupResponse.description:
Every suggestion for one local entry. `warning` is true when an
allergen or diet marker suggestion is among them.

PeerSuggestionRequest.title: PeerSuggestionRequest
PeerSuggestionRequest.description:
Names one suggestion: the peer, the kind, the entry's public id at
the peer and the field.

PeerSuggestionResponse.title: PeerSuggestionResponse
PeerSuggestionResponse.description:
One field of a local entry with the value a paired instance offers.
Field names and values follow the catalogue file and the reference data
updates; references are shown by name and conversions as unit code to
grams. Other names and conversions show the local value joined with the
peer's.

PrivacyAcknowledgementOverviewResponse.title: PrivacyAcknowledgementOverviewResponse
PrivacyAcknowledgementOverviewResponse.description:
Who acknowledged the current privacy statement version and who is
still asked, among the active people (service accounts are never asked).
Before the first statement both lists are empty.

PublicInfoResponse.title: PublicInfoResponse
PublicInfoResponse.description: What the login page needs before anybody signed in.

PublicStep.title: PublicStep
PublicStep.description:
A step. Mentions in `text` are rewritten for the visitor: an
ingredient or equipment item carries its current name and the zero id, a
public sub-recipe its title and public id, and a sub-recipe the visitor
may not see the name `?` and the zero id, which the page shows as a
placeholder.

PublicSubRecipe.title: PublicSubRecipe
PublicSubRecipe.description:
A recipe used inside another. One the visitor may not see comes
without id and title, and still counts for allergens and nutrition.

RecipeEditResponse.title: RecipeEditResponse
RecipeEditResponse.description: The recipe as the editor works on it: every language, every id.

RecipeRevisionResponse.title: RecipeRevisionResponse
RecipeRevisionResponse.description:
The revision with its snapshot: the editable recipe in the shape of
`RecipeEditResponse` (by public id, without status, visibility and
shares) plus `schema_version` and `names`, the display names per locale
of every referenced ingredient, unit, tag, equipment item and
sub-recipe at that moment, by kind and public id.

RecipeVisibility.title: RecipeVisibility
RecipeVisibility.description:
Who may read a published recipe besides its owner, narrowest first. A
draft is always its owner's alone.

ReferenceUpdateResponse.title: ReferenceUpdateResponse
ReferenceUpdateResponse.description:
A seed update an edit holds back: the field's current value, the
seed's new value and the value the seed wrote before.

ResolvedPublicIdResponse.title: ResolvedPublicIdResponse
ResolvedPublicIdResponse.description:
What a public id opens: the kind of page, the public id of its row
(a step's recipe for a step) and the frontend path.

ResourceUsageResponse.title: ResourceUsageResponse
ResourceUsageResponse.description:
How often each resource is used. Tags, units and equipment count the
recipes the viewer may see that use them, each recipe once; categories
and families count the ingredients in them. Every item is listed, zero
included.

SelfDeletionImpact.title: SelfDeletionImpact
SelfDeletionImpact.description:
What deleting the own account does, computed for this user and this
instance. Backups keep the data until they rotate out.

SelfDeletionRecipeFates.title: SelfDeletionRecipeFates
SelfDeletionRecipeFates.description:
What happens to the own recipes when the user deletes the public
recipes too, in the fields of the same names in `SelfDeletionImpact`.

SelfDeletionRequest.title: SelfDeletionRequest
SelfDeletionRequest.description:
Confirms the deletion with the own e-mail address and either the
password or a passkey assertion.

ShoppingItemUpdate.title: ShoppingItemUpdate
ShoppingItemUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; send amount or unit_id as null to clear.

ShoppingListMode.title: ShoppingListMode
ShoppingListMode.description: How a shopping list treats what was bought and how long it lives.

ShoppingListNoteResponse.title: ShoppingListNoteResponse
ShoppingListNoteResponse.description: An idle list the viewer was on deleted itself.

ShoppingListUpdate.title: ShoppingListUpdate
ShoppingListUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. Anyone on the list renames it and
switches mode and keep; only the owner changes the members.

StaleStepView.title: StaleStepView
StaleStepView.description:
A step the variation names that changed (`changed`) or went
(`deleted`) since the revision it is based on, with its text then.

StepImageResponse.title: StepImageResponse
StepImageResponse.description:
An image a step of a visible recipe shows, offered for another step.
`step_number` counts from 1 and `step_text` is that step's text in the
viewer's language without marks or mentions. `matches` counts the
ingredients and equipment items the step shares with the step being
edited.

StepIngredientRequest.title: StepIngredientRequest
StepIngredientRequest.description:
A catalogue ingredient or a sub-recipe, exactly one. A sub-recipe's
amount is in its yield unit (scaled by amount / yield) or, without one,
in servings of the sub-recipe.

StepMarkerView.title: StepMarkerView
StepMarkerView.description:
What differs in one step of the applied recipe; `position` matches
`recipe.steps[].position`, `origin_step` is the original's number
(null for a step the variation adds).

SubRecipeNeed.title: SubRecipeNeed
SubRecipeNeed.description:
A sub-recipe the recipe needs: the line's amount scaled to the
servings, and how many batches of the sub-recipe that is.

SubRecipeRef.title: SubRecipeRef
SubRecipeRef.description:
A recipe used inside another. A sub-recipe the viewer may not see
comes without id and title ("a recipe you don't have access to"), and
still counts for allergens and nutrition.

SuggestionReason.title: SuggestionReason
SuggestionReason.description:
Why the meal plan suggests a recipe: the signal that weighed most in
its score (`meal_suggestions.score`).

TagKind.title: TagKind
TagKind.description:
Diets are no tag kind: they are derived from the ingredients' diet
markers.

TranslationRequest.title: TranslationRequest
TranslationRequest.description:
One language of a recipe: its text, each step's text in order and,
optionally, each step ingredient's note per step and each declared
ingredient line's note in order.

UserSummaryResponse.title: UserSummaryResponse
UserSummaryResponse.description:
What every signed-in user may see of another account. The display
name is the nickname when the person chose to go by it, otherwise the
full name, which then stays private to the person and the admins.

VariationChangeKind.title: VariationChangeKind
VariationChangeKind.description: One difference a recipe variation makes to the original.

VariationChangeRequest.title: VariationChangeRequest
VariationChangeRequest.description:
One change; which fields count depends on `kind`:

- `swap`: `ingredient_id` → `to_ingredient_id` in step `step`, or in every
  step with `step` null. `keep_amount` (default) keeps each line's amount,
  unit and note; otherwise `amount`, `unit_id` and `note` replace them.
- `add_line`: `ingredient_id`, `amount`, `unit_id`, `note` in step `step`.
- `remove_line`: the lines of step `step` naming `ingredient_id` or
  `sub_recipe_id`.
- `step_text`: `text` instead of step `step`'s text.
- `extra_step`: a new step after step `step` (0 puts it first) with
  `text`, `duration_minutes`, `lines` and `equipment`.

Steps are numbered from 1 as the recipe is now. `id` keeps an existing
change's id on an update; leave it out for a new change.

VariationChangeView.title: VariationChangeView
VariationChangeView.description:
A stored change with the names of what it refers to, in the viewer's
language. `available` is false when a record it names no longer
exists; `applies` is false when its step or line is no longer in the
recipe. Either way it is left out of the applied recipe.

VariationViewResponse.title: VariationViewResponse
VariationViewResponse.description:
The recipe with the variation applied, in the shape of the recipe
detail: ingredient list, nutrition, allergens, diets, the viewer's
warnings, the dinner-guest flag and the kitchen are derived from the
applied recipe; the rating fields are the variation's.

WebAppManifestResponse.title: WebAppManifestResponse
WebAppManifestResponse.description:
The web app manifest (W3C Web Application Manifest) that lets a
phone or a desktop browser install the instance as an app under its own
name. Paths are absolute, since the manifest is served below /api while
the app lives at the root.

WebhookSecretResponse.title: WebhookSecretResponse
WebhookSecretResponse.description: Answers create and rotate: the only time the secret is shown.
